title: DEM source declaration (bundle-level)
description:
Spec 19 §'DEM source handling defined upfront'. A bundle that uses a DemFeatureKernel stage in any biome's kernel chain MUST declare each referenced DEM source under `worlds/<bundle>/dem/sources.json` (an array of these). The pipeline tool `tx_dem_prepare` reprojects + crops + indexes the raw DEM and writes the prepared GeoTIFF + sidecar matching this schema.

References:
- Spec 19 §'KernelComposer' (DEM stages in a chain)
- Spec 22 §'Catalog schema' (per-biome kernel chains)
- Spec 12 (cache participation via DEM source path hash)

id.description: Unique source ID within the bundle. Referenced by DemFeatureKernel stages as `params.source = '<id>'`. Lowercase + underscores only (filesystem-friendly).

path.description: Path to the prepared GeoTIFF (or .npz/.npy) relative to the bundle root. Convention: `dem/<id>.tif`. Pipeline tool tx_dem_prepare emits this.

crs.description: Coordinate Reference System of the prepared DEM (e.g. 'EPSG:32610' for UTM zone 10N). The pipeline tool reprojects from the source CRS to whatever CRS the bundle author specifies (typically a local UTM zone for accuracy).

bounds_world_xz.description: World-XZ bounds [min_x, min_z, max_x, max_z] in METERS. The DEM array's (0, 0) maps to (min_x, min_z); (rows-1, cols-1) maps to (max_x, max_z). Walking_demo authors a small 4 km × 4 km patch from a Cascades excerpt; larger worlds split into tiles per Sprint 4's pyramid scheme.

elevation_range_m.description: DEM elevation [min_m, max_m] in meters above sea level. Used by the world contract to validate that biome elev bands are compatible. The pipeline tool computes this from the prepared raster's statistics.

source_resolution_m.description: DEM cell size in meters (e.g. 10.0 for USGS 10m NED, 30.0 for COP30). Informational — actual sampling resolution at runtime is driven by grid_n in the request, not this. Useful for asset-bar tuning.

attribution.description: License + attribution string for downstream display (e.g. 'USGS 10m National Elevation Dataset, public domain'). The world contract REQUIRES this for non-public-domain sources.
